issues.quote: I have no Plan B other than continuing my studies at Cisame,
Mage training was astronomically expensive. Hundreds of Ethons.
not merely for a place at CISAME
For CISAME residents, the Card even covered expenses like designer outfits and cozy houses.
And if you stayed at Cisame, you might never even have to pay interest on the endlessly compounding debt. Because in Seraph, absolutely nothing came for free.
Which was no easy feat—starting from the second circle, a mage was already fully capable of working; by the fourth, however, any hope of paying off debts was out the window.
uncovering the mysteries of the Plans, poetry, or metaphysically treading the gossamer layers of the True Plan
Agness waited for an expository pause

strengths.quote: After all, someone had to repair the megabarges. Torture demons.
Sift through the scrap scavenged from Shards by the Gathers to find treasures—or at least LED bulbs.
Carve hearts from corpses for healing potions…
letting Theodore marinate in the unenviable prospects
